questions.question: Distinguish the 1617 Rabdologiae from the posthumous account of constructing logarithms: the museum dates Rabdologiae shortly before Napier’s death, while a different book appeared posthumously. Check the attribution to his son Robert against title pages and approve both versions.

questions.question: Verify the exact birth date of 1 February, the claim that every table value is wrong beyond the sixth digit and the first-error-free-edition claim for 1857. Establish the source and translation of the full epigraph before final approval.
